competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease its Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance. The damage increases according to your Attack Speed.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 times to decrease their Attack Bar by 50% with a 50% chance. The damage increases by 50% if the target's Attack Bar is 0.

effets.note: If the targets Attack Bar is 0

competences.description: Gains immunity against inability effects. Increases your Attack Bar by 50% when an ally (excluding yourself) under an inability effect gets a turn. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: When an ally (excluding yourself) under an inability effect gets a turn

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an attack that always has an attribute advantage and ignores effects that resist death. If you have attacked the enemy target with HP below 30%, deals additional damage by 30% of the target's MAX HP (10% if it's a boss). [Thunderclap and Flash Godlike Speed] can be used twice per battle, and increases your Attack Bar by 50% after using the skill.

effets.description: The skill always has an elemental advantage regardless of monster elements.
Ignores all effects that resist death

effets.note: If the target has below 30% HP (10% if a boss)

effets.description: Skill has a limited number of usages per battle.
